{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to string and inspect for invisible characters
sales_df['revenue_str'] = sales_df['revenue'].astype(str)

# Use repr() to see hidden characters in the string
hidden_chars = sales_df['revenue_str'].apply(repr)

# Look for any non-printable characters (e.g., \u200b, \xa0, \u200e)
import re
invalid_pattern = re.compile(r'\u[0-9a-f]{4}|\xa0|\u200b|\u200e|\u200f')

# Check if any rows contain such characters
has_hidden = hidden_chars.apply(lambda x: bool(invalid_pattern.search(x)))

# Show the rows with hidden characters
hidden_rows = sales_df[has_hidden]

# Display the raw string and its repr for inspection
hidden_rows[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_str', 'revenue_str'].apply(repr)]"}
